jobs.title: Travelling Destination Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

The Travelling Destination Manager drives the performance, consistency, and growth of the Destination Experiences operation across the fleet by supporting onboard teams, enhancing the guest experience, and ensuring alignment between commercial objectives, operational standards, and Company strategy.

Your Impact

Contribute to revenue growth, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence by coaching onboard teams, identifying improvement opportunities, implementing best practices, and ensuring the successful execution of Destination Experiences initiatives across the fleet. Through regular ship visits, audits, and performance reviews, drive continuous improvement and support the achievement of departmental and company goals.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of managerial experience within cruise operations, shore excursions, hospitality, tourism, revenue management, or a related field.
• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to analyze performance and identify growth opportunities.
• Experience in training, coaching, and developing multicultural teams.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience working with operational KPIs, guest satisfaction metrics, and revenue targets.
• Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the fleet.

Your Essentials

Valid Passport

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager

titleByLocale.it: Strategia, Testing e Responsabile CRO di Analisi Digitale
titleByLocale.en: Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager
titleByLocale.de: Digital Analytics Strategie, Testing und CRO Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing et CRO Manager

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Junior Architect Port Development Intern
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

jobs.title: Digital Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Il Senior Digital Acquisition Manager sarà responsabile di guidare la strategia di marketing digitale in tutti i mercati MSC Crociere, con l'obiettivo di guidare le vendite dirette attraverso leve pubblicitarie digitali, l'impostazione e il raggiungimento di KPI, e lo sviluppo di campagne digitali innovative attraverso più canali. Il candidato di successo avrà una comprovata esperienza nel marketing delle prestazioni e nello sviluppo delle vendite digitali in un ROAS positivo, insieme a una forte esperienza nella strategia di campagna pubblicitaria digitale, nella pianificazione e nell'implementazione dei media pagati e nella leadership del team. Inoltre, il ruolo coinvolgerà lo sviluppo di programmi di affiliazione e partnership come parte di una strategia di coinvolgimento digitale integrata per ampliare la portata, guidare il traffico qualificato e sostenere il valore del cliente a lungo termine.

Il tuo impatto

• Sviluppare e mantenere forti relazioni con gli stakeholder di MSC su vari mercati, con una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze aziendali, sfide e opportunità, mentre bilanciare gli obiettivi globali stabiliti dalla sede centrale.

• Impostare e raggiungere i KPI per le vendite online tramite leve pubblicitarie digitali, assicurando che l'agenzia media offra obiettivi e obblighi contrattuali.

• Condurre incontri interni, QBR e recensioni annuali fornendo informazioni strategiche e raccomandazioni basate sulle prestazioni della campagna, analisi del sito web, tendenze del mercato e il paesaggio competitivo.

• Pianificare e implementare innovative campagne di marketing delle prestazioni attraverso i canali Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio e Video, che rispondono agli obiettivi aziendali e alle dinamiche di mercato.

• Collaborare con i team interni, inclusi i partner Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product e Agency, per garantire la tempestiva consegna di beni di alta qualità allineati con obiettivi di vendita digitali annuali.

• Identificare e perseguire opportunità per migliorare i flussi di reddito attraverso strategie digitali esistenti e nuove, migliorando la campagna ROAS e sperimentando innovazioni nell'ecosistema adtech e martech.

• Sviluppare e gestire le strategie di lead generation, assicurando flussi di acquisizione dei clienti efficaci e alimentando tattiche sono in atto in tutti i punti di contatto dei media pagati.

• Mantenere la supervisione del risourcing del conto e la redditività per garantire la gestione efficiente e proficua del QQ e dei mercati locali.

• Servire come punto di escalation principale per le preoccupazioni sollevate da squadre interne o da parti interessate del mercato locale.

• Controllo continuo e ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro operativi, proponendo e implementando miglioramenti di processo laddove pertinenti.

• Collaborare con gli stakeholder di paese e HQ per preparare e gestire il budget di marketing digitale annuale, allineato con gli obiettivi di fatturato di MSC Crociere B2C.

• Guidare e ottimizzare i programmi di affiliazione e partnership per guidare il traffico qualificato e le conversioni, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia di acquisizione digitale e obiettivi di performance.

• Gestisci partner chiave e iniziative co-branded, coordinando con i team interni per garantire l'esecuzione e il monitoraggio senza soluzione di continuità.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• 7+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile.
• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di analisi e ad server come GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager e i relativi framework di reporting.
• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione, mentoring e membri del team upskilling.
• L'esperienza passata nella strategia e nell'esecuzione della generazione di piombo è un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza solida nella proprietà del bilancio e nel controllo dei costi.

I tuoi essenziali

• Fluente in inglese (le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus).
• Forte capacità analitiche e capacità di sfruttare i dati per il processo decisionale informato.
• Provato track record di guidare la crescita delle vendite dirette e migliorare ROAS attraverso campagne pubblicitarie digitali ad alto rendimento.
• Passione per il marketing digitale, i supporti di performance e le soluzioni digitali innovative.
• Una profonda conoscenza delle piattaforme Google e Meta ad, tra cui l'audit di configurazione, l'implementazione e l'analisi delle prestazioni con approfondimenti attuabili.
• Ottimi capacità organizzative, di project management e di problem solving.
• Proficiente in Microsoft Office e strumenti di visualizzazione dati come Datorama.
• Forte capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente tra team interfunzionali e partner esterni.
• Capacità di identificare le tendenze dei dati e di trasformare le intuizioni in raccomandazioni strategiche attuabili.
• Self-starter con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere iniziativa.
• Presentatore fiducioso e articolato, impegnativo con attori senior e team interni.
• Forte pensiero strategico, in grado di agire come ‘consulente esperto’ alla leadership senior.
• Alta attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
• Atteggiamento positivo, mentalità proattiva, e un tentativo di abbracciare nuove sfide.
• Conoscenza di piattaforme affiliate come Awin, Kwanko e strumenti simili. Forte rete di contatti del settore per avviare opportunità di partnership e collaborazioni di brand.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Dein Zweck

Der Senior Digital Acquisition Manager wird für die Leitung der digitalen Marketingstrategie in allen MSC Cruises-Märkten verantwortlich sein, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf der Förderung des Direktvertriebs durch digitale Werbehebel, der Festlegung und Erreichung von KPIs und der Entwicklung innovativer digitaler Kampagnen über mehrere Kanäle hinweg liegt. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Performance-Marketing und in der digitalen Vertriebsentwicklung bei einem positiven ROAS haben, zusammen mit einer starken Expertise in der Strategie für digitale Werbekampagnen, der Planung und Implementierung bezahlter Medien und der Teamführung. Darüber hinaus wird die Rolle die Entwicklung von Zugehörigkeits- und Partnerschaftsprogrammen als Teil einer integrierten digitalen Engagement-Strategie umfassen, um die Reichweite zu erweitern, qualifizierten Traffic zu fördern und den langfristigen Kundenwert zu unterstützen.

Ihre Wirkung

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu MSC-Stakeholdern in verschiedenen Märkten, mit einem tiefen Verständnis ihrer Geschäftsanforderungen, Herausforderungen und Chancen – und gleichzeitig Abwägung der globalen Ziele der Zentrale.

• Festlegung und Erreichung von KPIs für Online-Verkäufe durch digitale Werbehebel, um sicherzustellen, dass die Medienagentur gegen Ziele und vertragliche Verpflichtungen liefert.

Führen Sie interne Meetings, QBRs und jährliche Überprüfungen durch die Bereitstellung strategischer Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen auf der Grundlage der Kampagnenleistung, Website-Analysen, Markttrends und der Wettbewerbslandschaft.

• Planen und implementieren Sie innovative Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen für Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio und Video-Kanäle - zugeschnitten auf Geschäftsziele und Marktdynamik.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams – darunter Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product und Agenturpartner – um die zeitnahe Lieferung von hochwertigen Assets zu gewährleisten, die auf die jährlichen digitalen Verkaufsziele ausgerichtet sind.

• Identifizieren und verfolgen Sie Möglichkeiten zur Steigerung der Einnahmequellen durch bestehende und neue digitale Strategien, während Sie die Kampagnen-ROAS verbessern und mit Innovationen im Adtech- und Martech-Ökosystem experimentieren.

• Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Lead-Generierungsstrategien, um sicherzustellen, dass effektive Kundenakquisitionsströme und Pflegetaktiken in allen Paid Media Touchpoints vorhanden sind.

• Behalten Sie die Aufsicht über die Resourcing und Rentabilität von Konten bei, um sicherzustellen, dass das Hauptquartier und die lokalen Märkte effizient und profitabel verwaltet werden.

• Dienen Sie als Haupteskalationspunkt für Bedenken, die von internen Teams oder lokalen Marktakteuren geäußert werden.

• Kontinuierliche Überprüfung und Optimierung der operativen Arbeitsabläufe, Vorschlag und Umsetzung von Prozessverbesserungen, wo relevant.

• Zusammenarbeit mit den Interessenvertretern des Landes und des Hauptquartiers, um das jährliche Budget für digitales Marketing im Einklang mit den B2C-Umsatzzielen von MSC Cruises vorzubereiten und zu verwalten.

• Leitung und Optimierung von Affiliate- und Partnerschaftsprogrammen, um qualifizierten Traffic und Conversions zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf die digitale Akquisitionsstrategie und Leistungsziele sicherzustellen.

• Verwalten Sie wichtige Partner und Co-Branding-Initiativen und koordinieren Sie sich mit internen Teams, um eine nahtlose Ausführung und Nachverfolgung zu gewährleisten.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Brand & Product
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Parte del team di Marketing globale e riportando direttamente al Brand Director, questo ruolo svolge un ruolo centrale nella salvaguardia, nella modellazione e nell'attivazione del marchio Explora Journeys in tutti i punti di contatto, con una particolare attenzione alle campagne di marca, alla flotta e ai nuovi sviluppi del marchio.

Situato nella nostra sede di Ginevra, questo ruolo si trova all'intersezione della strategia di marca, della narrazione dei prodotti e dell'esecuzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media e Digital per portare il marchio alla vita con chiarezza, consistenza e profondità emotiva, attraverso i mercati.

Il tuo impatto

Gestione e Governance dei marchi

- Agire come tutore principale del marchio Explora Journeys, supportando il Brand Director nella gestione quotidiana, nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione del marchio.

- Assicurare l'applicazione coerente di identità di marca, tono di voce, messaggistica e linguaggio visivo in tutti i punti di contatto, canali e viaggi degli ospiti.

- Condurre lo sviluppo, l'evoluzione e la manutenzione delle linee guida, dei framework e dei toolkit master, garantendo rilevanza, chiarezza e scalabilità a livello globale.

- Monitorare l'esecuzione del marchio su mercati e partner, identificare proattivamente le incongruenze e lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder per salvaguardare gli standard di lusso e ospitalità.

- Contribuire a iniziative di strategia di marca, progetti di evoluzione del marchio e formazione interna del marchio, rafforzare la comprensione e l'allineamento del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione.

Campagne, contenuti e attività di marca

- Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di campagne di master brand e prodotti, in linea con la strategia del marchio e le priorità commerciali.

- Superare la creazione di eroi e beni di prodotto, tra cui visivi chiave, quadri di copia, brochure, fotografia e videografia.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Media, Digital e PR per garantire un'espressione coerente e premium del marchio attraverso canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati.

- Gestire e curare i contenuti di marca, prodotto e flotta all'interno dei sistemi DAM e PIM, garantendo precisione, facilità d'uso e adozione di mercato globale.

Marketing del prodotto – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Possedere e articolare la narrazione del marchio e del prodotto per la flotta Explora Journeys, traducendo il design delle navi, le esperienze a bordo e la filosofia di servizio in avvincente, chiaro, e guest-centric storytelling.

- Agire come partner chiave del marchio per i team di Product, New Builds e Hotel Operations, supportando progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita della nave; dal concetto iniziale alla consegna, al lancio e all'evoluzione in-service.

- Definire e attivare proposizioni e concetti a livello di nave, esperienze a bordo, concetti suite, pilastri culinari, benessere e vendita al dettaglio, e rituali di servizio.

- Assicurare l'allineamento tra l'esperienza ospite a bordo e la promessa del marchio comunicata al mercato.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Supporto del marchio e prontezza del prodotto per nuove iniziative di marca, campagne, lanci delle navi, grandi pietre miliari e innovazioni a bordo.

- Sviluppare strumenti di lancio master per dotare canali, mercati, vendite e PR con chiare narrazioni, posizionamento e attività.

- Assicurare coerenza, chiarezza e allineamento del marchio in tutte le comunicazioni interne ed esterne relative a marca, flotta ed evoluzione del prodotto.

Collaborazione funzionale e eccellenza operativa

- Agire come partner di marca di fiducia attraverso le funzioni, promuovendo l'allineamento tra brand, prodotto, commerciale e team operativi

- Coordinare budget, fornitori, previsioni, ordini di acquisto e fatturazione relative alle iniziative di marca.

- Equilibrare il marchio strategico pensando con le mani sull'esecuzione in un ambiente veloce.

- Laurea magistrale in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, o in un campo relativo.

- 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del marchio e nella costruzione di campagne.

- Esperienza prioritaria all'interno di lusso, premium o high-end di viaggio, ospitalità o marchi di consumatori fortemente preferito.

- Esperienza comprovata che opera in un ambiente di quartier generale globale, gestione dei quadri di marca e dei beni master in tutti i mercati.

- Esperienza di agenzie di gestione e partner creativi esterni.

- Esposizione al marketing del prodotto e ai prodotti basati sull'esperienza fisica (ship, hotel, resort o ambienti premium complessi altamente desiderabili).

- Forte sensibilità creativa combinata con rigore operativo, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

- Comodo spostamento tra pensiero strategico del marchio e esecuzione dettagliata.

- Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un forte vantaggio.

Basé à notre siège social à Genève, ce rôle se situe à l'intersection de la stratégie de la marque, du conte de produits et de l'exécution, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media et Digital pour donner vie à la marque avec clarté, cohérence et profondeur émotionnelle, sur les marchés.

- Élaborer des outils de lancement pour équiper les canaux, les marchés, les ventes et les relations publiques de récits, de positionnements et d'actifs clairs.

- Assurer la cohérence, la clarté et l'alignement de la marque dans toutes les communications internes et externes liées à l'évolution de la marque, du parc automobile et du produit.

Collaboration transfonctionnelle et excellence opérationnelle

- Agir en tant que partenaire de marque de confiance pour toutes les fonctions, en favorisant l'alignement entre les équipes de marque, de produit, commerciale et opérationnelle

- Coordonner les budgets, les fournisseurs, les prévisions, les bons de commande et la facturation liés aux initiatives de marque.

- Équilibrer la pensée stratégique de marque avec l'exécution mains sur mains dans un environnement à rythme rapide.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Maîtrise en marketing, gestion de marques, marketing de produits ou un domaine connexe.

- 8+ ans d'expérience dans la gestion de marque et la construction de campagnes.

- Expérience antérieure dans le luxe, les voyages haut de gamme, l'hospitalité ou les marques de consommateurs fortement préférées.

- Expérience éprouvée dans un environnement mondial de siège, gestion des cadres de marques et maîtrise des actifs sur les marchés.

- Expérience des agences de gestion et des partenaires créatifs externes.

Vos essentiels

- Exposition à la commercialisation de produits et à des produits basés sur l'expérience physique (navires, hôtels, stations balnéaires ou des environnements complexes haut de gamme hautement souhaitables).

- Une forte sensibilité créative associée à une rigueur opérationnelle, une attention aux détails et des compétences en gestion des intervenants.

- Un déplacement confortable entre la réflexion stratégique de marque et l'exécution détaillée.

- La maîtrise de l'anglais; d'autres langues européennes présentent un fort avantage.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Come Casino Slot e Technical Operations Manager, sarai responsabile del monitoraggio delle prestazioni delle slot machine, analisi dei dati di gioco e delle strategie di attuazione per migliorare la soddisfazione e la redditività del giocatore. Il vostro ruolo coinvolgerà ispezioni regolari e pianificazione di manutenzione per garantire che tutte le slot machine funzionino correttamente ed efficacemente. • Gestire budget, costi di controllo e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse.

Discutere le aree di preoccupazione specifiche per l'Operazione e il prodotto specifico del marchio, e allo stesso modo affrontare i punti di encomio.

• Analisi delle entrate, identificazione delle tendenze con la capacità di creare soluzioni strutturate per aumentare o migliorare i flussi di reddito. Esplora nuovi modi per aumentare i ricavi esistenti e /o migliorare le pratiche di lavoro attuali, mantenendo allo stesso tempo un elevato standard tecnico e di sicurezza a bordo delle nostre navi.
• Isolare le aree sotto lo standard con i membri del team di gestione del Casino Shipboard.
• Formazione di tutti i team di gestione in Slot Revenue, Sicurezza e Sorveglianza.
• Confermare che le misure di sicurezza soddisfano i requisiti minimi.
• Fornire assistenza e consulenza per la risoluzione dei problemi tramite e-mail ai team tecnici di bordo.
• Valutare, valutare e rivedere i dati per l'organizzazione di progetti e/o fornire indicazioni su attività, attività o processi secondo le linee guida aziendali.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume di marketing, digitale e commerciale per unire il nostro marchio di viaggio di lusso di nuova creazione Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

- L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare gli investimenti di marketing full-funnel in modo olistico, massimizzare l'impatto dei ricavi e l'ottimizzazione ROI sui mercati. Questo ruolo è responsabile dell'analisi delle prestazioni attraverso il viaggio del cliente — dalla consapevolezza attraverso la lealtà — per identificare le opportunità di crescita, migliorare l'efficienza di marketing e guidare i risultati commerciali attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati.
Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni di marketing contro i KPI di marca e commerciali, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per un miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI di marketing chiave attraverso touchpoint (tutti i canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati), le campagne e le prestazioni del pubblico.

- Efficienza dell'azionamento, quantificando ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA per campagna, touchpoint e pubblico per ogni mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomandare reinvestimenti verso attività ad alto impatto, per colpire obiettivi di sensibilizzazione e ricavi.

- Costruisci e mantieni i segnapunti full-funnel per mercato (consapevolezza → considerazione → conversione → lealtà) per identificare i colli di bottiglia di reddito e ottimizzare l'allocazione di bilancio tra i mercati. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione (ad esempio mix media, attribuzione multi-touch) per chiarire il contributo delle entrate attraverso le piattaforme e migliorare l'efficienza degli investimenti.

- Partner di Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue team per prevedere impatti di investimento e allineare le attività di marketing con risultati commerciali.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure Investments (Caribbean)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal de projet - Investissements en infrastructure (Caraïbes)

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

eccelle nel trasformare la complessità in chiarezza? Sei eccitato plasmando idee, presupposti stimolanti e amplificando l’impatto di un leader?
Stiamo cercando un New Builds Development & Delivery Manager che agirà come estensione del Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, migliorando il pensiero strategico, migliorando la velocità decisionale e aiutando a portare concetti robusti e di alta qualità alla leadership senior.
Questo ruolo non è operativo e non è una posizione di presentazione. Si tratta di un ruolo di partnership, progettato per qualcuno che può pensare criticamente, strutturare problemi ambigui, sfidare intuizioni e sostenere lo sviluppo di concetti di esperienza degli ospiti trasformazionali. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild e Strategy, assicurando che i concetti siano analiticamente sani, orientati agli insight e allineati alle aspettative dell'azienda. Potrai ottenere l'esposizione a discussioni strategiche, influenzare il processo decisionale senior, e guidare la chiarezza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di innovazione.
Se sei un pensatore acuto, un sfidante naturale, e un partner affidabile in grado di elevare il lavoro degli altri, questo è il ruolo per voi

Il tuo impatto

Supporto strategico e partenariato di pensiero

- Agire come partner strategico diretto al Senior Manager, aiutando il pensiero della struttura, i problemi della struttura e affinare le narrazioni dei concetti.

- Partecipare o condurre riunioni selezionate per conto dell'Innovazione dell'esperienza ospite

- Preparare brevi strategici, quadri decisionali e documenti di sintesi per conversazioni a livello SVP.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Comunicazione

- Materiali di storytelling chiari, concisi e strategicamente sani per forum di leadership

- Trasformare informazioni complesse in narrazioni ad alto impatto.

- Sostenere la leadership nella preparazione delle discussioni del Comitato SVP/EVP/Executive.

Collaborazione trasversale

- Coinvolgere con i team Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy e Operations per raccogliere idee e concetti di forma.

- Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di nuovi concetti di intrattenimento, esperienze e spazi attraverso la nostra flotta.

- Agire come il collegamento chiave tra partner creativi, operazioni e funzioni aziendali, garantendo allineamento e buy-in in ogni fase.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Guidare la chiarezza nei flussi di lavoro strutturando le linee temporali, identificare i punti di decisione e anticipare i rischi.

- Seguire con gli stakeholder per garantire il progresso e l'allineamento.

- Elevare i problemi presto e proporre scenari di mitigazione.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5-8 anni di strategia, innovazione, business design, consulenza o gestione strategica del progetto.

- L'esperienza in ospitalità, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, beni di consumo, o l'esperienza degli ospiti è un vantaggio forte.

- Forte sfondo nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di esperienze orientate agli ospiti, dal concetto alla consegna.

- Un equilibrio di creatività e know-how operativo, in grado di sognare grande e consegnare praticamente.

- Provato track record nella gestione di team complessi e interfunzionali (operazioni, creativo, marketing, vendite, ricavi, comunicazioni), con la capacità di unire prospettive diverse intorno a una singola visione.

- Ottima conoscenza dei moderni strumenti di comunicazione visiva (Canva, Adobe Suite, piattaforme creative basate su AI) per produrre documenti visivi e attività di storytelling oltre i tradizionali ponti di scorrimento.

- Eccellente capacità di costruzione di relazioni; in grado di ispirare, influenzare e connettersi tra diverse squadre.

- Forte capacità di narrazione e presentazione, con fiducia a livello esecutivo.

- Capacità di viaggiare 20-30% del tempo.

- Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive a plus.

I tuoi essenziali

- Proficienza in Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook.

- EU Passport o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Zweck

Können Sie Komplexität in Klarheit verwandeln? Werden Sie durch die Gestaltung von Ideen, die Herausforderung von Annahmen und die Verstärkung der Wirkung eines Führers angetrieben?
Wir suchen einen New Builds Development & Delivery Manager, der als Erweiterung des Senior Manager of Concept Innovation fungiert, das strategische Denken verbessert, die Entscheidungsgeschwindigkeit verbessert und dazu beiträgt, robuste, qualitativ hochwertige Konzepte in die Geschäftsleitung zu bringen.
Diese rolle ist nicht operativ und keine präsentationsaktualisierungsposition. Es ist eine Partnerschaftsrolle, die für jemanden gedacht ist, der kritisch denken, mehrdeutige Probleme strukturieren, Insights herausfordern und die Entwicklung transformierender Gästeerlebniskonzepte unterstützen kann. Sie arbeiten eng mit Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild und Strategie zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Konzepte analytisch fundiert, aufschlussreich und auf die Erwartungen des Unternehmens ausgerichtet sind. Sie werden sich strategischen Diskussionen aussetzen, die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften beeinflussen und Klarheit über Innovations-Workstreams hinweg schaffen.
Wenn Sie ein scharfer Denker, ein natürlicher Herausforderer und ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind, der in der Lage ist, die Arbeit anderer zu erhöhen, ist dies die Rolle für Sie

Ihre Wirkung

Strategische Unterstützung & Thought Partnerschaft

- Handeln Sie als direkter strategischer Partner des Senior Managers und helfen Sie dabei, das Denken zu strukturieren, Probleme zu formulieren und Konzeptnarrative zu schärfen.

- Nehmen Sie an ausgewählten Meetings teil oder leiten Sie diese im Namen von Guest Experience Innovation

Bereiten Sie strategische Briefings, Entscheidungsrahmen und Synthesedokumente für Gespräche auf SVP-Ebene vor.

Narrative Gebäude & Executive-Ready Kommunikation

Erstellen Sie klare, prägnante und strategisch fundierte Storytelling-Materialien für Führungsforen

Verwandeln Sie komplexe Informationen in wirkungsvolle Narrative.

- Unterstützung der Führung bei der Vorbereitung der SVP/EVP/Exekutivausschuss-Gespräche.

Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

- Engagieren Sie sich mit Experience-, Entertainment-, Retail-, Marketing-, Newbuild-, Strategie- und Operations-Teams, um Erkenntnisse zu sammeln und Konzepte zu gestalten.

Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung neuer Unterhaltungskonzepte, Erlebnisse und Räume in unserer gesamten Flotte.

Handeln Sie als zentrales Bindeglied zwischen kreativen Partnern, Betrieb und Unternehmensfunktionen und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung und das Buy-in in jeder Phase.

Projekt- und Stakeholdermanagement

- Steigern Sie Klarheit in den Workstreams, indem Sie Zeitpläne strukturieren, Entscheidungspunkte identifizieren und Risiken antizipieren.

- Follow-up mit Stakeholdern, um Fortschritte und Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.

Erhöhen Sie Probleme frühzeitig und schlagen Sie Minderungsszenarien vor.

Deine Reise bisher

- 5-8 Jahre in Strategie, Innovation, Business Design, Beratung oder strategischem Projektmanagement.

- Erfahrung in Gastfreundschaft, Kreuzfahrt, Einzelhandel, Konsumgütern oder Gästeerlebnis ist ein starkes Plus.

- Starker Hintergrund bei der Gestaltung und Durchführung gastorientierter Erlebnisse, vom Konzept bis zur Lieferung.

- Ein Gleichgewicht von Kreativität und operativem Know-how, in der Lage, groß zu träumen und praktisch zu liefern.

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Teams (Betrieb, Kreativität, Marketing, Vertrieb, Umsatz, Kommunikation) mit der Fähigkeit, verschiedene Perspektiven um eine einzige Vision zu vereinen.

Ausgezeichnetes Wissen über moderne visuelle Kommunikationstools (Canva, Adobe Suite, KI-gesteuerte Kreativplattformen), um überzeugende visuelle Dokumente und Storytelling-Assets jenseits traditioneller Foliendecks zu erstellen.

Ausgezeichnete beziehungsaufbauende fähigkeiten; in der lage, verschiedene teams zu inspirieren, zu beeinflussen und zu verbinden.

Starke Storytelling- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen auf Führungsebene.

- Fähigkeit, 20-30% der Zeit zu reisen.

- fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Plus.

Ihre Essentials

- Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook.

- EU-Pass oder Recht auf Arbeit in der Schweiz.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Vous excellez à transformer la complexité en clarté ? Êtes-vous énergisé en formant des idées, en contestant des hypothèses et en amplifiant l'impact d'un leader?
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un nouveau gestionnaire du développement et de la prestation des nouvelles constructions qui agira à titre d'extension du gestionnaire principal de l'innovation conceptuelle, améliorera la pensée stratégique, améliorera la rapidité de prise de décisions et aidera à apporter des concepts robustes et de haute qualité aux cadres supérieurs.
Ce rôle n'est pas opérationnel ni un poste de mise à jour de présentation. Il s'agit d'un rôle de partenariat, conçu pour quelqu'un qui peut penser critiquement, structurer des problèmes ambigus, remettre en question les idées, et soutenir le développement de concepts d'expérience d'invité transformationnelle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les intervenants de Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild et Strategy, en veillant à ce que les concepts soient solides sur le plan analytique, axés sur les idées et conformes aux attentes de l'entreprise. Vous serez exposé à des discussions stratégiques, influencerez la prise de décisions et favoriserez la clarté dans tous les secteurs de l'innovation.
Si vous êtes un bon penseur, un challenger naturel, et un partenaire de confiance capable d'élever le travail des autres, c'est le rôle pour vous
